reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 2 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hawks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 55 times in 100, by about 1; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.

analyst.text: Detroit lost at home to Toronto on Friday but get Cade Cunningham back (probable, knee), while Jalen Duren and Duncan Robinson stay out and Ron Holland is questionable. Atlanta have won three straight and eight of 11, and Jalen Johnson broke out of a shooting slump with 26 on Friday, but the Hawks are without CJ McCollum and rookie Kingston Flemings is questionable with a back issue. Both teams are banged up; the angle leans slightly towards Atlanta at home.
